name: Albedo Wing

perks.name: Ballistic Tuning
perks.desc:
Power diverted from shield.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases shield duration

perks.name: Supercooled Accelerator
perks.desc:
Optimized for extended range.
  •  Increases range
  •  Slightly decreases reload speed
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Tempered Truss Rod
perks.desc:
High stiffness for quick handling.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases reload speed
  •  Slightly decreases range

perks.name: Low-Impedance Windings
perks.desc:
Improved output efficiency.
  •  Increases shield duration
  •  Slightly increases reload speed
  •  Decreases range

perks.name: Auxiliary Reserves
perks.desc:
Additional energy storage.
  •  Greatly increases shield duration
  •  Decreases reload speed

perks.name: Lightweight Emitter
perks.desc:
Weight reduction for better agility.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases handling speed
  •  Decreases shield duration

perks.name: Extended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Alloy Magazine
perks.desc: Faster reload when the magazine is nearly empty.

perks.name: Appended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon's magazine is built for higher capacity.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Accurized Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Swap Mag
perks.desc: Increases this weapon's ready and stow speed.

perks.name: Light Mag
perks.desc:
Improved reload and range.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Grave Robber
perks.desc: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Beacon Rounds
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant your projectiles tracking and increase reload speed. Dealing further damage extends the duration.

perks.name: Replenishing Aegis
perks.desc: Blocking damage partially reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Eddy Current
perks.desc: Temporarily increases reload speed and handling after sprinting or while amplified. This effect is improved when you are amplified.

perks.name: Strategist
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon generate class ability energy. Activating your class ability briefly improves this weapon's stability.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Air Trigger
perks.desc: Increased ammo generation. When airborne, accuracy and reload speed are increased but target acquisition is decreased.

perks.name: Immovable Object
perks.desc: Dealing ranged damage grants increased weapon energy while you're stationary with your shield raised.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Clown Cartridge
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.desc: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.desc: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Close to Melee
perks.desc: Glaive projectile final blows improve Glaive melee damage. Glaive projectile or melee damage extends the duration.

perks.name: Voltshot
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

perks.name: Collective Action
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Deconstruct
perks.desc:
Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Dawning Surprise
perks.desc: Defeating targets awards a Dawning gift. Defeated powerful targets count as more than one.

perks.name: Häkke Breach Armaments
perks.desc:
This weapon deals increased damage against vehicles and constructs.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 126 from 17 December 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6SVRlV4ttvPkAm9HA44Km0?si=a9d7a25536b747c3) with @ImpetusAlways, @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-MinorSpec PvE-MajorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for bulkier Minor adds and Majors in general, and end-game underleveled content. If you're into the glaive life, Albedo Wing provides some variety, being one of the few aggressive frames available. At base the stats are solid - 38 Range equates to 19.09m and a projectile speed of 117m/s, 35 Handling is a 0.35s ready and 0.42s stow time, 30 Shield Duration is 9.95s when fully charged and 30 Reload Speed is a 2.98s reload. Magazine size is 4 (max 6) and with 0/1/2/3 Reserves mods, you'll have total ammo of 25/28/32/34 (max 36). You can focus on the shield duration stat with the haft perk for major damage reduction in PvE. Although the reload speed is also poor, we can get around that with traits, so Appended Mag ups mag size by one. In the first trait column, Replenishing Aegis refills the magazine by one on blocking damage with your shield or Grave Robber procs on glaive melees, and Close to Melee in the second boosts melee damage by ×1.3 for a projectile hit - all this works well with Titan Synthoceps or Hunter Triton Vice and Flow State. The Dawning Surprise origin trait is pretty potent for PvE - 6 Minor add rapid kills drops a "gift" for your fireteam which on pickup grants +20% energy to all your abilities, restores 22HP and starts health regeneration. Recommended MW: Shield Duration, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Ionic Traces or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader.

Adamsdown_Boy written v8.1.5.1 (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-MinorSpec PvE-MajorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): PvE pick for bulkier Minor adds and Majors in general, and end-game underleveled content. If you're into the glaive life, Albedo Wing provides some variety, being one of the few aggressive frames available. At base the stats are solid - 38 Range equates to 19.09m and a projectile speed of 117m/s, 35 Handling is a 0.35s ready and 0.42s stow time, 30 Shield Duration is 9.95s when fully charged and 30 Reload Speed is a 2.98s reload. Magazine size is 4 (max 6) and with 0/1/2/3 Reserves mods, you'll have total ammo of 25/28/32/34 (max 36). You can focus on the shield duration stat with the haft perk for major damage reduction in PvE. Although the reload speed is also poor, we can get around that with traits, so Appended Mag ups mag size by one or Light Mag improves things a little. In the first trait perk column, Eddy Current when procced speeds up reload and adds handling while Collective Action in the second boosts projectile damage by ×1.2 for picking up an elemental pickup - enhance this and add in the Synergy weapon mod to generate Ionic Traces and that should be happening plenty. The Dawning Surprise origin trait is pretty potent for PvE - 6 Minor add rapid kills drops a "gift" for your fireteam which on pickup grants +20% energy to all your abilities, restores 22HP and starts health regeneration. Recommended MW: Shield Duration, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Ionic Traces.

Panda (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Eddy Current and Low-Impedance Winding give you 100 reload when you're Amplified making it way easier to proc Voltshot with every shot and reload. Air Trigger does give you close to max but doesn't quite hit there. If you're looking to use Albedo Wing as a primary you should opt for Air Trigger for better reserves." Recommended MW: Shield Duration.

Panda (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Closing time and Light Mag will bring your range up to 100. Auxiliary Reserves and Shield MW will get you to 55 shield duration. Add in Close to Melee for easier clean ups after your massive 100 range shot." Recommended MW: Shield Duration.

Stallion (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "I don't look for much in Glaives these days, but I do like Golden Tricorn, and Beacon Rounds can be fun. More Arc stuff. Voltshot feels a little pointless, so more gooder damage." Recommended MW: Shield Duration.

Stallion (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "I.. Got nothing. More abilities. Get some freeloads from Demo, the shield duration tank should be fine (I hope) I really dont know what glaives want, but this seems fun to me." Recommended MW: Range.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 91 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/50NPk7xF3Tt6X3DVucE9jU?si=44d2b7d44a5a4aec) with @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways. First-choice PvE pick for add-clear of bulkier Minor, and Major Spec enemies in end-game content. Only the second Aggressive Glaive subtype so there's not much of a comparison to make, but Albedo Wing seems to have decent stats. The range is good, so you can focus on the shield duration stat with the haft perk for major damage reduction in PvE. Although the reload speed is also poor, we can bypass that with traits, so Appended Mag ups mag size by one. In the first trait column, Grave Robber procs on glaive melees, or Field prep boosts reserves, and reload speed when crouched, and Close to Melee in the second boosts melee damage by 30% for a projectile hit. The Dawning Surprise origin trait is very useful in PvE - when the behind the scenes counter hits 100, the surprise is spawned on the ground for 10s and grants 10% energy to all abilities, grants 20HP and starts shield/health regeneration. Recommended MW: Shield Duraction, with a damage boosting (Minor, Major or Taken Spec) mod.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 91 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/50NPk7xF3Tt6X3DVucE9jU?si=44d2b7d44a5a4aec) with @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways. First-choice PvE pick for burst damage against Major Spec enemies in end-game content with an arc subclass. Only the second Aggressive Glaive subtype so there's not much of a comparison to make, but Albedo Wing seems to have decent stats. The range is good, so you can focus on the shield duration stat with the haft perk for major damage reduction in PvE. The reload speed is poor, and Light Mag is the only perk that helps. In the first trait column, Clown Cartridge can overflow the magazine on reload to 5 or 6, and there are plenty of arc grenades (the glaive melee doesn't count unfortunately), to proc the second stack of Golden Tricorn with for a 50% damage boost for 10s. The Dawning Surprise origin trait is very useful in PvE - when the behind the scenes counter hits 100, the surprise is spawned on the ground for 10s and grants 10% energy to all abilities, grants 20HP and starts shield/health regeneration. Recommended MW: Reload Speed or Shield Duraction, with a damage boosting (Major or Taken Spec) mod.

Panda (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "I don't know how often this glaive will be used over the crafted gloves but there's a nice niche between Beacon Rounds and Close to Melee. If you get any glaive kill you'll activate Beacon Rounds, with the added tracking you can shoot off in the general direction of a thrall and with that kill you'll activate Close to Melee to deal an extra 30% more melee damage. Any additional damage with your melee or projectile you'll keep up Beacon Rounds and Close to Melee to continue the chaining of better tracking and better damage." Recommended MW: Range.

Panda (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "With Auxiliary Reserves you get some great shield duration. With Light Mag and Keep Away you negate the reload speed loss from Auxiliary Reserves. All the range gives you a velocity of 130 m/s which is 1.11x times faster than the base 117 m/s. This extra speed will make the hit registration feel better. If you can manage to get Golden Tricorn 2x with one surge mod you can one hit kill any guardian 6 resilience or below. As you add one surge mod you can down an additional resilience tier. It scales 1:1." Recommended MW: Range.

Stallion (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Okay here's my thought process.. This weapon needs to be really unique to justify using over a crafted Glaive. What makes it unique is Beacon Rounds. Beacon Rounds are an ease of use perk, they're built to make you miss less shots without slowing down combat by aiming (gross, all my homies hate aiming). So my plan is to make myself a one man phalanx, storming forward with homing shots that aim themselves. Demolitionist to help me panic reload, plus just keeping my grenade energy up, and more shield duration to aid in the goal of becoming phalanx. Also, Honourable mention to Golden Tricorn potentially being very fun to mess around with." Recommended MW: Shield Duration.

Stallion (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Okay so.. Glaives in PvP. Not my favourite thing. But here's what I'm thinking: Max Range for max projectile speed, bonus handling to make it less hefty to switch to, Beacon Rounds because auto-aim potentially gooder, demo simply because there's nothing else I feel is worth using in that slot. High Impact Reserves is only a 6% damage boost, Golden Tricorn might be tricky to keep active in PvP, Lead From Gold serves no purpose in PvP.. It's just tricky. I'm sorry I can't provide more, I'm really not a glaive in PvP kinda fella." Recommended MW: Handling.
